{{- /* The whole manual in one text, for an agent that reads it in one fetch:
       llms.txt, then every page's Markdown under its address, by name. Read
       from the installed pages at each request, so it never differs from
       them. */ -}}
{{- /* The address is built from request headers and printed as text. Refuse
       anything that is not a plain scheme and host name. */ -}}
{{- $proto := default (placeholder "http.request.scheme") (.Req.Header.Get "X-Forwarded-Proto") -}}
{{- if or (not (has $proto (list "http" "https"))) (not (regexMatch "^[A-Za-z0-9.-]+(:[0-9]+)?$" .Req.Host)) }}{{ httpError 400 }}{{ end -}}
{{- $base := printf "%s://%s" $proto .Req.Host -}}
{{ include "/llms.txt" }}
{{- range sortAlpha (listFiles "/") }}{{ if hasSuffix ".md" . }}
{{- $doc := splitFrontMatter (readFile .) }}

---

Address: {{ $base }}/{{ trimSuffix ".md" . }}

{{ trim $doc.Body }}
{{- end }}{{ end }}
